description: Build an unsigned transaction that pays USDC on Sui to tide's treasury for credits ($3 per million credits; 1 USDC buys 333,333). Returns base64 tx_bytes that need no SUI for gas (unless gas: true). Sign them with the paying address and send them, or POST them with the signature to https://api.tide.ad/v1/billing/topup/submit. Credits land on the paying address's account about a second after the transaction is final. With an API key the key's account pays; without one pass address. Free. Example: { usd: "10" }.

address.description: The paying Sui address, when you have no API key.

gas.description: true to pay gas in SUI instead of building a gasless transaction.

usd.description: USD of USDC to pay, at least 1, like "10" or "25.50".

name: billing_topup
title: Buy credits with USDC
